_about: Component spec for pos-close/pos-chevron control icons (docs/inspect refactor, 2026-08-27 — deferred from the 2026-08-26 batch since it was not in the pre-decided toggle list, migrated now as part of finishing the refactor). Reuses the data from the old buildControlIconsInspectSpec() dynamic builder in styleguide-component-page.js (verified-accurate, currently-live), restructured into the new schema. Layout section is generated at DEFAULT icon size (M toggle = --pos-size-icon-s, 16px); getControlIconsVariantSections() in the JS swaps in the currently-selected icon size at render time (S/M/L toggle maps to --pos-size-icon-xs/-s/-m respectively, per ICON_SIZE_MAP) rather than a static pick, since the existing Icon size toggle is a real, already-working control. Preview shows two very different sub-elements (Close/Chevron) side by side, so per the 2026-08-25/26 rule it got a NEW "Variant" toggle on the Variants tab, position 1 — filters the preview to one at a time (B2). Regenerate the spec partial with the script in RULES.md 6.4 if the source data changes; do not hand-edit token values here. Updated 2026-08-27: added usageExample/props/composedOf (Target architecture point 1 fields that were left empty when this spec was first generated).
name: Control icons
description: Close (dismiss) and Chevron (expand/collapse) control icon buttons used across the design system.
whenToUse: Chevron — expand / collapse: dropdowns, collapsible menus and navigation sections, accordions, tree views, expandable table rows, collapsible sidebars and panels, FAQ sections.
Close: closeable modals and dialogs, closeable alerts, messages and notifications, toasts, banners, closeable tags and chips, drawers and side panels, popovers.
whenNotToUse: Using as a decorative or purely informational icon — control icons always imply user interaction.
Using the chevron as a directional or navigation arrow — use a dedicated arrow icon instead.
Using the close icon as a "delete" or "remove record" action — use a trash / delete icon for destructive data operations.
do: Always use <button type="button"> as the element — never <div> or <span>.
Always include aria-label on close buttons describing exactly what will be closed or removed (e.g. "Close dialog", "Remove Electronics tag").
Use aria-expanded on chevron buttons to communicate state — rotation is driven by this attribute automatically.
Always pair aria-expanded with aria-controls pointing to the controlled panel's id.
Size control icons relative to their context — use the S token inside compact components (tags, dense lists), M as the default, L for prominent surfaces (dialogs, large cards).
dont: Nest a close button inside another <button> — interactive elements cannot be nested.
Use the chevron to indicate navigation to a new page — use a link with an arrow icon instead.
Rely on the icon alone to communicate state — always pair with aria-expanded or aria-label.
Use control icons purely for decoration — their animated behavior signals actionability.
accessibility: Close: aria-label must describe what is closed or removed, not just say "Close".
Chevron: set aria-expanded="false" by default; toggle to "true" when the panel is open.
Chevron: aria-controls must point to the id of the controlled panel.
Chevron: include a visually hidden <span class="pos-label"> as the accessible button label.

props.name: kind
props.description: pos-close: dismiss/remove action; pos-chevron: expand/collapse indicator, rotates via [aria-expanded].

props.name: size
props.description: Maps to --pos-size-icon-xs / -s / -m respectively (S/M/L toggle labels are one step up from the raw token scale).

usageExample:
<!-- Close button -->
<button type="button" class="pos-close" aria-label="Close">
  <!-- x icon -->
</button>

<!-- Chevron / expand button -->
<button type="button" class="pos-chevron"
  aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Expand section">
  <!-- dashRight icon -->
</button>
